checks.title: Validate one-micro Presentation capture and explicit triggers
checks.instructions: On a real workstation, run Presentation while speaking continuously. Trigger Jarvis with the configured manual wake key and, when Porcupine is available, the Jarvis wake word. Exercise start/stop and a normal voice response.
checks.expected: One physical input owner; ambient capture continues without device-busy conflicts; triggers are responsive under ambient load; playback/duplex remains stable.
